## Summary

Keep live SQLite Margin results with public `TRUE`/`FALSE` columns usable on either side of ordinary joins and set operations.

```diff
 Margin result's public lazy query
-  intermediate Boolean aliases depend on final result-class repair
+  private internal outputs -> inlinable public projection
+  quote generated references and keep the built projection opaque to CTE lifting
```

Closes #1136. Direct collection/materialization continues through the existing typed companion queries. Construction and rendering remain lazy; derived types and order follow ordinary dbplyr semantics.

## Evidence

- **Before:** live SQLite regressions raised `no such column: TRUE` on joins and `no such column: FALSE` on set operations. A subsequent CTE replay exposed lost public output names.
  **After:** focused binary tests pass for both positions, bag/set semantics, case variants, empty/populated fixtures, column roles, labels, Margin-order choices, summaries, and CTEs. Database execution is blocked during construction/rendering; rows inserted afterwards appear at collection.
- [Verification record](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1150#issuecomment-6592781160): full Review-ready PASS for `5079ed4af2bd14322e3457d7d6b4b5c8d831f32e`; 199/199 test files, 0 ERROR / 0 WARNING / 0 NOTE.
- [Review record](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1150#issuecomment-6573175125): Standards 0 findings; Spec 0 findings.

- CI follow-up: compare ordinary class-combination refusals, cover static callee proofs, and synchronize job deadlines with workflow contracts. No new code-review round ran for `5079ed4a`; the prior review remains pinned to `4bf69303`.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

The query-construction change can be reverted without migrating stored data.

**Blast Radius:** SQLite

Changes the public lazy-query representation of SQLite Margin results with Boolean-word names. Other dialects retain their existing paths.
